blocks.text: Free AI-powered video editor for social media content

CapCut has become the default video editor for social media creators, and the reason is simple: it offers professional-grade editing features for free. Auto-captions, background removal, speed ramping, green screen, and an extensive effects library - features that used to require expensive software and expertise.

The AI features are where CapCut really shines for efficiency. Auto-captions with customizable styles take minutes instead of hours. Background removal works on video (not just photos). Text-to-speech generates voiceovers in multiple languages. These AI tools turn a 30-minute editing session into a 5-minute one.

CapCut works across desktop, mobile, and browser - meaning you can start an edit on your phone, refine on desktop, and export from anywhere. For teams creating high volumes of social content, this flexibility keeps production moving regardless of where creators are working.
AI-generated subtitles with customizable styles and timing
AI-powered video background removal without green screen
Thousands of transitions, filters, stickers, and text animations
Export presets for TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels
AI voiceover generation in multiple languages and styles
Desktop, mobile, and browser editors with cloud project sync

For social media video production, CapCut's AI features and free pricing make it impossible to beat. Teams producing daily social content save hours every week on captions, effects, and formatting alone.
Our team can integrate CapCut into your workflow and automate the repetitive parts.
